tutormoments.citation: TutorMoments-Preview, Albert Zhang and colleagues, Allen Institute for AI and collaborators (2026).
tutormoments.selectionNote: Exact complete source JSONL lines 366 and 435, retained in source order including original newline bytes. No text, metadata, IDs, dates or events added or altered.
limitations: These are transcripts of real human tutoring sessions, not simulated student conversations and not native vendor clickstream exports.
Released text was transcribed by SUT (Gemini 2.5 Pro); preserve that provenance and do not call it verified verbatim audio or a perfect transcription.
Publisher deidentifies free text with fabricated surrogates or tags; apparent names in the selected text are not real per publisher documentation. UUIDv5 identifiers are publisher surrogates.
Absolute session dates are removed. start_seconds/end_seconds are relative source offsets; do not synthesize wall-clock event timestamps.
The source anonymizes the provider as tutoring_provider_a. Do not relabel it Khan Academy, MATHia, IXL, DreamBox or ALEKS.
Source enrichments are model-generated screen/pause narratives; do not convert them into observed assistance events.
Ground-truth annotations are LLM-assisted and action-taxonomy labels model-generated; this sample does not include either as observed learner events.
A question mark or Tutor role alone does not establish a hint request or help effectiveness. Preserve role/text conservatively; explicitly mark any semantic classification as derived.
No original recording is released (has_video false). Raw transcripts and their offsets cannot independently establish fidelity to underlying audio.
Data involves minors. No reidentification. Report residual PII and do not redistribute affected records per publisher guidance.

oatutor.citation: Pardos, Zachary; Bhandari, Shreya (2023). ChatGPT-generated help produces learning gains equivalent to human tutors on mathematics skills. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23935269.v1
oatutor.selectionNote: Exact source header and first 12 data records, preserving original bytes and CRLF newlines. No values, columns or records added or altered.
limitations: These are participant-level study summaries, not a product export or a hint/clickstream log.
condition is the assigned help condition, not proof that a participant opened or received a particular hint.
The participant table supplies no individual inquiry, hint text, event sequence or event timestamps.
The no-hint control still received correctness feedback and could request a bottom-out answer; assignment is not proof of no assistance.
The raw Human tutor condition means human tutor-authored hints, and ChatGPT means pre-generated ChatGPT solution hints. These are not recordings of live human or AI tutoring conversations.
preTest, postTest, sessionTime, totalUniqueSteps and learningGain remain original columns and values. No new effect size, pooled score or causal analysis is calculated.
anonUserID is a publisher anonymous participant identifier. Learnlog output replaces the known subject identifier with a scoped HMAC pseudonym. The original public sample remains unchanged.
